description: This file defines a PHP class `ADODB_odbtp_unicode`, which extends the `ADODB_odbtp` class to implement ODBTP Unicode driver support with Unicode SQL flag enabled. It includes metadata comments, licensing, and import of a related driver file.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_unicode
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADODB_odbtp to support Unicode via the ODBTP driver with UTF-8 encoding enabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherits constructor from parent ADODB_odbtp class, sets databaseType to 'odbtp' and enables Unicode SQL support.
